heading: From Enquiry to Plot Shortlist
text: Start with your budget and preferred plot size. We can then help you narrow the available options before you visit or proceed further.
stepsText:
Tell Us Your Budget | Send us your approximate budget, preferred plot size and any sector preference. | yes
Receive Current Options | We shortlist relevant Phase 2 plots and share current information with you. | yes
Compare Location & Price | Review the sector, road location, plot dimensions, special-location factors and total price. | yes
Verify Before Payment | Confirm the exact property details, applicable charges and documentation before making payment. | yes
Arrange a Site Visit | Visit the project and inspect the shortlisted location where possible. | yes
Proceed Through the Required Process | Once satisfied, complete the booking or purchase through the applicable official process. | yes
